quotes.text:
There is no Frigate like a Book
To take us Lands away
quotes.author: Emily Dickinson
quotes.source: There is no Frigate like a Book

quotes.text: The reading of all good books is like a conversation with the finest minds of past centuries.
quotes.author: René Descartes

quotes.text: How many a man has dated a new era in his life from the reading of a book.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.text: I declare after all there is no enjoyment like reading!
quotes.author: Jane Austen

quotes.text: And what is the use of a book, without pictures or conversations?
quotes.author: Lewis Carroll

quotes.text: Reading maketh a full man; conference a ready man; and writing an exact man.
quotes.author: Francis Bacon
